prompt: Animate KF1 to KF2 to KF3 as one threshold beat: preserve the same focal droplet identity while it is suspended, grows against a weakening updraft, then descends below the cloud base and leaves a clear narrow rain streak. Preserve the cloud-base lighting, blue atmospheric background, downward screen direction, and measured camera push. Avoid identity swaps, morphing, gray-background cutaways, extra focal droplets, labels, arrows, numbers, HUD graphics, and reverse gravity.

qc.review_note: The regenerated KF2-to-KF3 segment keeps the droplet and cloud background continuous and makes the downward threshold plus rain streak readable. Fast QC review is caused by near-duplicate samples at the segment join, with no decode, black, freeze, or structural failure.

fusion_deferred: Exact rain-threshold annotation and any explanatory arrows remain for Fusion at shots/S007/fusion/threshold_overlay.setting.
